bayesian.method: Matrix-normal inverse-Wishart conditional OU transitions; equal categorical prior over deadzone/drive/brake grid
limitations: Conditional likelihood treats thinned velocity residuals as Markov; reference and calibration systematic errors are not independent observations.
Common relaxation time preserves conjugacy; axis-dependent residual covariance captures coupled disturbances.
Posterior uncertainty is conditional on selected model family and training environment; coverage on heldout trials must be checked.

observation_scope: contiguous visually observed segments; endpoints are segment endpoints, not full trajectory endpoints
limitations: Empirical PWM response; tire friction, motor torque, mass and slip are not separately identifiable.
Heldout velocity metrics compare against the declared reference; IMU translation is not independent ground truth.
Residual covariance models observed trial variation; it does not certify safety or out-of-distribution behavior.
Deadzone and time constants selected on training trials; bootstrap conditions on these selected values.
deployment_role: Offline empirical probabilistic world-model candidate; not a calibrated native Gazebo motor parameter file or online motor controller.

provenance.scale_reference: visual-inertial scale estimated only on training trajectories; no external surveyed pose reference
provenance.raw_data_tracking: Raw runs are ignored by Git; these hashes identify the source recordings.

limitations: Metric scale shares accelerometer calibration; heldout images are independent of scale fitting but not an external surveyed reference.
Bootstrap resamples whole training trials and excludes systematic camera, IMU and mounting errors.
Floor homography ambiguity, vibration and tilt remain systematic errors; invalid alignment is not promoted.
Metric scale is shared visual-inertial, not surveyedexternaltruth.
